{{Quote|That's a gnasp hive. Be careful, they're nasty little buggers.|Bera Kazan|<ref name="TCWgame" />}}
'''Gnasps''' were wasp-like insects native to the moon of [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] system, [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. They were very large creatures that nested in giant underground holes and would attack in swarms. Gnasps had fang-like teeth and large stingers.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Bera Kazan]] encountered these creatures during their time on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]-dominated moon, shortly before the [[Battle on Alaris|battle of Alaris Prime]].

The [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft/Legends|fluttercraft]] used as patrol vehicles on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were named after these creatures.
